Name: hard
Definition: A generic adjective for 'hard', i.e. firm or solid. Antonym of 'soft'.

Name: animal
Definition: A generic noun for 'animal', i.e. any living and moving organism (not a human being).

Name: bad
Definition: A generic adjective for 'bad', i.e. unpleasant or unwelcome. Antonym of 'good'.
